On September 3, 2026, the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) launched the EOS-05 satellite, also known as GISAT-1A. This satellite is part of the GISAT series and is designed to enhance India's Earth observation capabilities. The launch was conducted using a GSLV Mark II rocket from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre. 

FINAL: EOS-05 satellite (GISAT-1A) was launched by ISRO.
